LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaSilkWhip.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid filament whip
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaSilkWhip.description: A short whip that constrains aphrodisiac nanofluid into fine filaments. Contact releases the swarm with minimal trauma; valid chained targets absorb it harmlessly for activation and limited repair.
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaPulseGun.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid pulse gun
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaPulseGun.description: A dedicated weapon firing three-pulse bursts of aphrodisiac nanofluid constrained into fine needle swarms. Suited to close and medium ranges. The needles disperse upon entering flesh.
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaProjectorGun.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid projector gun
LanguageData.SSC_Weapon_PnaProjectorGun.description: A precision projector that maintains a nanite swarm over long distances. Single shots offer high penetration; the swarm disperses inside the body without leaving a separate carrier.
LanguageData.SSC_Projectile_PnaPulse.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid pulse swarm
LanguageData.SSC_Projectile_PnaProjection.label: aphrodisiac nanofluid projection swarm
